results.name: Kineto Launches AI Agent for Influencer Marketing - TechEdgeAI
results.content:
Kineto's Kinetik AI agent automates creator discovery, outreach, content and analytics inside Slack and WhatsApp.
CreatorIQ’s 2025–2026 research similarly found that 71% of organizations increased influencer-marketing investment year over year, while average reported annual influencer marketing budgets rose 171%. Those numbers help explain why workflow automation is becoming a competitive issue for marketing teams. As budgets increase, companies need to manage more creators, more content and more measurement without necessarily expanding headcount at the same rate. Kineto’s specialization is also significant.
The platform also extends beyond influencer sourcing. Kineto says Kinetik can create SEO-focused articles, LinkedIn and X posts, and supporting visual assets while adapting outputs to a company’s brand voice. It can also connect campaign and product analytics from services such as GA4, Amplitude and Meta Ads.
Kineto’s website says Kinetik can connect to platforms including Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, as well as tools such as Canva, Notion and ElevenLabs. It also emphasizes persistent brand memory and proactive insights as differentiators from generic AI systems. That vertical approach could make the product easier to deploy for marketing teams, but it also raises questions about governance.
The company was spun out of the developer-tools business, and Kineto CEO Andrew Zakonov previously created Junie, JetBrains’ coding agent. The move suggests an interesting transfer of engineering expertise from developer AI into marketing automation. The bigger question is whether specialized agents can outperform collections of general-purpose AI tools. Most marketing organizations already have access to AI writing, analytics, social publishing and research products.

results.name: Kineto App review: My honest opinion after testing it 2026
results.content:
## What Is Kineto?  
**Kineto** is an AI-powered, cloud-based platform developed by **JetBrains** that allows users to create, deploy, and maintain web applications without writing a single line of code. Launched into Early Access in late 2025, it represents JetBrains’ first major foray into the “No-Code for Everyone” market.  
Unlike traditional website builders that focus on static pages, Kineto is designed for **“single-value” apps**. These are functional, interactive tools that solve a specific problem—think trackers, planners, quiz apps, or personal dashboards.  
It uses a concept many are calling “vibe coding,” where the user provides a [natural language](https://websites2know.com/macaly-review/) prompt, and the AI (reportedly powered by advanced models like GPT-5) handles the backend architecture, database schema, and UI design automatically.
### Is Kineto safe for my data?  
JetBrains is known for high security standards. Apps built on Kineto are hosted in secure cloud environments with GDPR-compliant data practices.
